title: AccommodationsDetailsRoomOutput
description: AccommodationsDetailsRoomOutput schema from Booking.com Demand API

id.description: A signed integer number that uniquely identifies an accommodation property room. The full list can be obtained by calling [accommodations/details](/demand/docs/open-api/demand-api/accommodations/accommodations/details).

attributes.description: Lists a set of attribute qualifiers for this room. Will not be returned if no relevant attributes are applicable.

bed_options.description: Lists all possible bedding options for this room or apartment.

items.description: List of all possible bed arrangements. For apartments and other types of hotel accommodations, beds and bathrooms may be available as separate rooms.

bed_configurations.description: Lists all alternative bed configurations that are supported.

items.description: List of all beds available for this configuration.

configuration.description: Detail list of all different types and number of beds included in this configuration.

items.description: Detail information about a type of bed and number of beds included in this configuration.

bed_type.description: A signed integer number that uniquely identifies a bed type. Examples of bed types are: Single, Double etc. The full list can be obtained by calling accommodations/constants.

number_of_beds.description: Number of similar beds included in this configuration.

has_bathroom.description: Flags if this area includes its own bathroom.

is_bedroom.description: Flags if this area is marked as a bedroom, otherwise, it should be considered a living room.

cots_and_extra_beds.description: Lists room options regarding adding cots and/or extra beds.

are_allowed_together.description: Flags if cots and extra beds can be placed together in the room. `true` allows both up to their maximum limits. `false` requires exclusive choice of either cots or extra beds.

maximum_number_of_cots.description: Maximum number of cots that can be added.

maximum_number_of_extra_beds.description: Maximum number of extra beds that can be added.

are_allowed.description: Flags if it's possible to add cribs and/or extra beds.

maximum_number_of_cribs.description: Maximum number of cribs that can be added.

maximum_number_of_extra_beds.description: Maximum number of extra beds that can be added.

description.description: Translated description of this room. The maximum number of characters returned may be limited by contract.

items.description: A signed integer number that uniquely identifies an accommodation property room facility. Examples of facilities are: Coffee/Tea maker, TV, Airconditioning, etc. The full list can be obtained by calling accommodations/constants.

children.description: Maximum number of children allowed (children will be typically defined by being under 18 years of age).

total_guests.description: **DEPRECATED** Total capacity of adults + children allowed.

bedrooms.description: Total number of rooms equipped or that can be fitted with a bed.

living_rooms.description: Total number of rooms without a bed.

photos.description: List of photos for this accommodation room. The maximum number of photos returned may be limited by contract. Requires `{"extras":["rooms","photos"]}`. The photos are returned in no particular order.

main_photo.description: Flags this as the main photo. Not returned otherwise.

items.description: A list of tags associated with the photo. Manually generated.

large.description: URL of the photo image with a maximum width of 1280 pixels.

standard.description: URL of the photo image with a maximum width of 500 pixels.

thumbnail.description: URL of the photo thumbnail image with dimensions 100x100 pixels.

thumbnail_large.description: URL of the photo thumbnail image with dimensions 300x300 pixels.

room_type.description: A signed integer number that uniquely identifies an accommodation property room type. Example of room types are: Suite, Apartment, Twin/Double etc. The full list can be obtained by calling accommodations/constants.

size.description: The room area in square meters.
